blocks.text: GREEN Lab is a meeting place. We work with community groups, traditional custodians, councils and volunteers to care for the grasslands together.
Volunteer days run year-round — weeding, seed collection, monitoring and planting. No experience needed. Tools, gloves and morning tea provided.
